author: fable-cursor
criterion: Mossy greens soften every hard edge as in the reference house roof and boulders.
note: Moss does not soften every hard edge: the A stair treads show clean straight nosings with no moss (x 0.55-0.90, y 0.10-0.70); the house cap's eave at B is a clean arc over the bark with a shadow band rather than an irregular tufted fringe, and the cap reads as smooth mottled green paint with a specular sheen. Boulder moss at C is present. The reference's moss is tufted, overhangs the eave and creeps over every stair nosing. mossCoverage / mossJoints / mossRoof pass the gate; the read does not.
